fixes.explanation: That's right, baker. The text says the Israelites gave the Levites these cities and pasturelands "…out of their own inheritance…" (Joshua 21:3). Think about that. Giving up a piece of your own land is like handing over the corner pieces of a fresh batch and saying, "Take the good ones." They did it "…by the command of the LORD…" and gave from what was already theirs.
